name: LinkedIn Thought Leadership Post Drafter - Complete

assignments.name: target_audience
assignments.value: Technology professionals, AI and Data Science professionals, founders, students and business leaders

assignments.name: voice
assignments.value: Professional, insightful, practical, confident and human. Avoid corporate buzzwords.

assignments.name: bookmarked_content
assignments.value:
BOOKMARK 1 — AI adoption: Many organizations are moving from AI experiments to production systems. The biggest challenge is not simply choosing a model; it is building reliable workflows, evaluating outputs, protecting data and creating measurable business value.

BOOKMARK 2 — Responsible AI: Successful AI products need human oversight, clear evaluation criteria, transparent limitations and a process for handling incorrect or unsafe outputs. Trust is part of product quality.

BOOKMARK 3 — Technology leadership: Strong technical leaders connect technology decisions to customer problems. Instead of discussing technology only in terms of features, they explain why a change matters, what trade-offs it creates and what teams should do next.

assignments.name: content_instructions
assignments.value: Create ONE original LinkedIn thought-leadership post using the bookmarks as inspiration. Do not claim personal experiences that are not provided. Do not copy source wording. The post should have a strong opening hook, one central insight, practical value, a clear point of view, and an engaging question. Keep it around 180–260 words. Use short paragraphs and LinkedIn-friendly spacing. Add 4–6 relevant hashtags.

Follow the requested JSON schema exactly.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt } ] }) }}
